description: This source file establishes a WebSocket client connection to a local server, sends a JSON-RPC request to invoke the 'add' method in the 'org.rdk.Calculator.1' service with parameters 2 and 2, and handles incoming messages by logging the received data.

methods.name: client.onopen
methods.description: Handler invoked when the WebSocket connection is established; sends a JSON-RPC request.

methods.name: client.onmessage
methods.description: Handler invoked upon receiving a message, parses and logs the message data.
